spans.s:
Spandana in one passage of the Rigveda^1 denotes a certain
tree. Roth,^2 however, reads syandana, ‘chariot.’
1) iii. 53, 19.
2) St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
Cf. Aufrecht, Rigveda, 2, vi; Zimmer,
Altindisches Leben, 63.

Sparśu is apparently the name of a western people in the
Baudhāyana Śrauta Sūtra (xxi. 13).
